options.name: controller_config_file
options.description: Path to the controller config file. If provided, the other locations for config files will not be considered.

options.name: controller_host
options.description: URL to your Automation Platform Controller instance. If value not set, will try environment variable C(CONTROLLER_HOST) and then config files If value not specified by any means, the value of C(127.0.0.1) will be used

options.name: controller_oauthtoken
options.description: The OAuth token to use. This value can be in one of two formats. A string which is the token itself. (i.e. bqV5txm97wqJqtkxlMkhQz0pKhRMMX) A dictionary structure as returned by the token module. If value not set, will try environment variable C(CONTROLLER_OAUTH_TOKEN) and then config files

options.name: controller_password
options.description: Password for your controller instance. If value not set, will try environment variable C(CONTROLLER_PASSWORD) and then config files

options.name: controller_username
options.description: Username for your controller instance. If value not set, will try environment variable C(CONTROLLER_USERNAME) and then config files

options.name: credential_passwords
options.description: Passwords for credentials which are set to prompt on launch

options.name: credentials
options.description: Credential names, IDs, or named URLs to use for job, only used if prompt for credential is set.

options.name: diff_mode
options.description: Show the changes made by Ansible tasks where supported

options.name: execution_environment
options.description: Execution environment name, ID, or named URL to use for the job, only used if prompt for execution environment is set.

options.name: extra_vars
options.description: extra_vars to use for the Job Template. ask_extra_vars needs to be set to True via job_template module when creating the Job Template.

options.name: forks
options.description: Forks to use for the job, only used if prompt for forks is set.

options.name: instance_groups
options.description: Instance group names, IDs, or named URLs to use for the job, only used if prompt for instance groups is set.

options.name: interval
options.description: The interval to request an update from the controller.

options.name: inventory
options.description: Inventory name, ID, or named URL to use for the job, only used if prompt for inventory is set.

options.name: job_slice_count
options.description: Job slice count to use for the job, only used if prompt for job slice count is set.

options.name: job_timeout
options.description: Timeout to use for the job, only used if prompt for timeout is set. This parameter is sent through the API to the job.

options.name: job_type
options.description: Job_type to use for the job, only used if prompt for job_type is set.

options.name: labels
options.description: Labels to use for the job, only used if prompt for labels is set.

options.name: limit
options.description: Limit to use for the I(job_template).

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the job template to use.

options.name: organization
options.description: Organization name, ID, or named URL the job template exists in. Used to help lookup the object, cannot be modified using this module. If not provided, will lookup by name only, which does not work with duplicates.

options.name: request_timeout
options.description: Specify the timeout Ansible should use in requests to the controller host. Defaults to 10s, but this is handled by the shared module_utils code

options.name: scm_branch
options.description: A specific of the SCM project to run the template on. This is only applicable if your project allows for branch override.

options.name: skip_tags
options.description: Specific tags to skip from the playbook.

options.name: tags
options.description: Specific tags to use for from playbook.

options.name: timeout
options.description: If waiting for the job to complete this will abort after this amount of seconds. This happens on the module side.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to allow insecure connections to AWX. If C(no), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates. If value not set, will try environment variable C(CONTROLLER_VERIFY_SSL) and then config files

options.name: verbosity
options.description: Verbosity level for this job run

options.name: wait
options.description: Wait for the job to complete.
